name: § 177, point iii – 43
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section III – Commission and executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: (iii) report to the Parliament on progress towards implementation of the Pact on Migration and Asylum and grant the Parliament access to all relevant documents to facilitate effective democratic oversight of the implementation process;
